title: Peanut butter cups
summary: Dark chocolate shells around a salty, sweetened peanut butter centre, made in a muffin tin.
steps: Line a 12-hole mini or standard muffin tin with paper cases.
Melt both chocolates with the coconut oil over barely simmering water, then whisk in the powdered erythritol until smooth.
Spoon about 2 tsp chocolate into each case and tilt to coat the base and a little way up the sides. Freeze 10 minutes.
Stir the filling ingredients together until smooth and thick. Roll into 12 balls, flatten each into a disc slightly smaller than the cases, and press one onto each chocolate base.
Cover with the rest of the chocolate, tapping the tin to level it. Refrigerate 1 hour, until firm. Keep chilled.
tips: Check the chocolate chips are dairy-free: many sugar-free brands contain milk fat.

origin.history: The chocolate peanut butter cup was created in 1928 in Hershey, Pennsylvania, by H. B. Reese, a former employee of the Hershey company who had started his own candy business. It became one of the best-selling sweets in the United States.
